officialText:
Periodic boiler inspections shall be performed in accordance with this article and the provisions of section 1011.3 of the New York city mechanical code.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
